data.cultural_impact: The name Sarukh in Hindu culture is associated with power, prosperity, and good fortune. The prefix "Saru-" means "lord" or "ruler," and the suffix "-kh" denotes "auspiciousness" or "good fortune." Thus, Sarukh is seen as a name that signifies the possessor or ruler of all things good and prosperous.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Sarukh holds greater significance, representing one's connection to the divine and the positive energies of the universe. The prefix "Saru-" signifies the divine and the ruler of all things, while the suffix "-kh" represents the auspiciousness and positive energy that flows from the divine to the individual.
